messages.subject: DT::renderDataTable  Issue
parts:
I am running code on a server and trying to get it to work. When I ran it locally there was no problem. Now that it is on the server though I am getting the following error. Uncaught TypeError: table.rows(...).every is not a function  I am not sure what to do. The DT library has been sourced and everything. 

For example :
 ###Renders entire data table from file

This doesn't work. What should I do ?


Thanks,

Amber
